source.method: read-only Substrate JSON-RPC plus polkadot-cli 0.7.0 storage metadata and one-key query

OriginalAccount.description: Map an Ethereum H160 address to its original AccountId32; reverse mapping for reconstructing the original native account.

notes: This is an observation from one RPC endpoint at the recorded finalized block, not independent authentication of that endpoint.
The raw metadata digest is a per-observation value, not a trusted runtime identity pin; earlier inspections returned a different digest while reporting the same specVersion.
The synthetic H160 query was intentionally limited to one fixed non-user key and does not establish the mapping for a real wallet.
The CLI was exercised through the new one-key verifier; it emitted a structured no_mapping_entry result, a reported chain ID, and the finalized block/runtime snapshot.
Current runtime metadata exposes Revive.OriginalAccount as the H160-to-AccountId32 storage; Revive.AddressSuffix is absent in this runtime.
